test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pipe R can empty a full tank in 30 hours. But two pipes P and Q can fill the tank in 15 hours and 10 hours, respectively. Ram unknowingly opened all three taps. After 2 hours Shyam realised it and closed Pipe R. Due to this mistake how much time more would it take to fill the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work (LCM of 15, 10, 30) = 30 units.

Efficiencies: P = +2, Q = +3, R = −1. Combined (P+Q+R) = 4.

Work done in 2 hours = 4 × 2 = 8 units. Remaining = 30 − 8 = 22 units.

Time with P and Q only = 22 ÷ 5 = 4.4 hours (4 hr 24 min).

Time if R was never open = 30 ÷ 5 = 6 hours. But from t=0, P+Q take 30/5 = 6 hours. After 2 hours, they would need 4 hours. Extra time = 4 hr 24 min − 4 hr = 24 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 **Pipe** **Time (hrs)** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 **Pipe P** (Fill) 15 30 units +2 
 **Pipe Q** (Fill) 10 +3 
 **Pipe R** (Empty) 30 −1 

⇒ **Combined efficiency** of P, Q and R = 2 + 3 − 1 = 4 units/hr

⇒ Work done in first 2 hours = 4 × 2 = 8 units

⇒ **Remaining work** = 30 − 8 = 22 units

⇒ After closing R, efficiency of (P + Q) = 2 + 3 = 5 units/hr

⇒ **Actual time** to complete remaining work = 22 ÷ 5 = 4.4 hours = 4 hours 24 minutes

⇒ **Ideal time** needed after 2 hours (if R was never open) = (30 − (5 × 2)) ÷ 5 = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 hours

⇒ **Extra time taken** = 4 hr 24 min − 4 hr = 24 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 24 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Negative Efficiency

In **Pipes and Cisterns**, an emptying pipe (leak) is always assigned a **negative efficiency** while a filling pipe is assigned a positive one.

Time and Work Relation

Efficiency × Time = Total Work. Total work is usually taken as the **LCM** of the individual time periods for easier calculation.

Extra Time Calculation

Extra time is the difference between the **actual time taken** to fill the tank and the **scheduled time** if no error/leak occurred.</p
